assumptions: The two named constraint outputs form the joint surrogate target vector; their 0.5 weights reproduce the paper's ranking scalarization exactly.
The registered genomic intervals are fetched from the UCSC mm39 assembly and must pass the recorded SHA-256 digests before a program can be built.
The ENCODE track identifier and model-specific output indices were verified against the canonical Enformer and Borzoi mouse target manifests named in global_parameters.accessibility_track.

The smoke variant uses one 128-bp target cycle with one 128-bp accessibility pulse, reduces the proposal count, and truncates the authenticated 40,960-bp prompt to its final 4,096 bp so one binding can execute on an 80-GB GPU; it is a wiring test and has no paper-comparable AUROC.
BeamSearchOptimizer seed 0 controls local proposal selection, but Evo2Generator itself exposes no seed parameter.
Every full-Proto versus fused-Proto comparison uses the same BeamSearchOptimizer seed; Evo 2 model-internal seed control remains explicitly false in both arms.
unknowns: The paper does not disclose a model-generation random seed.
